text.content:
The most expensive coastline on Earth, until the war.

Region: Night City, the southern coast. Districts: Coastview (O), West Wind Estate (P), the Occupied Zone (Q)
Controlled by: Three powers: the Voodoo Boys (Coastview, West Wind), Barghest (the Occupied Zone) and the NCPD (one building)
The feel of it: Half-built hotels, a mall with no roof, and an amusement park with its lights off
Notable locations: Batty's Hotel, the Grand Imperial Mall, Precinct 9, Radio Lakay; Hotel Pistis Sophia, Serenity Bible Church, Playland by the Sea; EBM Petrochem Stadium, Black Sapphire, Eden Plaza, Terra Cognita
Danger: Combat in Coastview and West Wind; Occupied in the Occupied Zone

From 2063 investors bet on Pacifica as the most expensive coastline on Earth: West Wind Estate, the Grand Imperial Mall, Playland by the Sea reborn, and the EBM Petrochem Stadium, built by thousands of Haitian refugees from the 2062 storm. Then the war came and the money left overnight, leaving half-built hotels and construction workers nobody paid to send home. The NUSA came next, then Barghest, then the Accord, which stopped the war everywhere except here.

Pacifica Now

  • Services. Night Corp has cut most of the CitiNet, NCART and garbage service. Holophone calls drop more often than they connect. Trauma Team doesn't cover Pacifica; REO Meatwagon goes in for triple fare.
  • Not a combat zone. Commissioner Ramos refuses to declare it one, and Precinct 9 in Coastview is officially open with almost nobody left to send.
  • Getting in. The Pacifica Bridge is the only road from the north. Barghest checkpoints hold the south and east roads. The Pacifica Line has been suspended since the war.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.19; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.12
